cases.name: receiver-in-variadic-list
cases.source:
class Box:
 def run(*items):return items
box=Box()
values=box.run(3,4)
print(values[0] is box,values[1:])

cases.name: no-positional-formal
self-keyword-collision
lowered-to-lowered-mixed-call
live-protocol-keyword-defaults
escaped-receiver-aliases
cases.source:
class Box:
 def run(self,*items,**kw):return self,items,kw
box=Box()
method=box.run
a,items,kw=method(box,other=box)
print(a is box,items[0] is box,kw['other'] is box,method.__self__ is box)
